product_overview: A client-facing app that generates a personalized "Wrapped" summary from a public GitHub username, presenting animated metric cards and shareable images for social platforms.
core_goals: Allow anyone to generate a year-in-review summary for a public GitHub user without authentication.
Aggregate public GitHub profile, repo and event data server-side and present computed yearly metrics.
Provide an engaging, animated card carousel to explore metrics and enable easy sharing/export of visual cards.
Generate a dynamic Open Graph image for rich social previews when Wrapped pages are shared.

features.name: Username Search and Navigation
features.description: Enter a GitHub handle from the landing page and navigate to a personalized Wrapped page for that user.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill the GitHub username input field -> Submit the form to generate Wrapped -> Get redirected to /[username] -> See the user's Wrapped preview load

Navigate to / -> Fill the GitHub username input field with a non-existent username -> Submit the form to generate Wrapped -> Get redirected to /[username] -> See error UI indicating the username is invalid or could not be found

features.name: GitHub Data Aggregation
features.description: Server-side fetch of public GitHub profile, repos and activity to compute year-based stats and feed the Wrapped cards.
user_flows: Navigate to /[username] -> Server fetches GitHub profile, repos and events -> Wait for server-rendered cards and computed metrics to load -> See profile summary and metric cards populated

Navigate to /[username] -> Server fetches GitHub profile, repos and events -> Receive a 404 or API rate-limit response from GitHub -> See error UI indicating the username is invalid or rate limit was reached

features.name: Animated Wrapped Card Carousel
features.description: Interactive carousel presenting computed metrics as animated cards with keyboard, pointer and swipe navigation methods.
user_flows: Navigate to /[username] -> See first metric card rendered in the carousel -> Use right keyboard arrow to advance -> Card animates and the next metric card becomes visible
Navigate to /[username] -> See first metric card rendered in the carousel -> Swipe horizontally on a touch device to advance -> Card animates and the next metric card becomes visible
Navigate to /[username] -> See progress dots for the carousel -> Tap a progress dot to jump -> Carousel animates directly to the selected card

Navigate to /[username] in an environment with JavaScript disabled or reduced motion -> Cards render statically or without animation -> Keyboard and swipe interactions are unavailable and user sees a static stack or fallback navigation

features.name: Social Sharing and Image Export
features.description: Export the current card as a PNG and open share intents for social platforms so users can post their Wrapped highlights.
user_flows: Navigate to /[username] -> Focus the desired metric card in the carousel -> Export the current card as PNG -> Receive a downloadable PNG of the card

Navigate to /[username] -> Focus the desired metric card in the carousel -> Open the Twitter share intent with a prefilled message and page URL -> See the platform share window with the prefilled content

Navigate to /[username] -> Focus the desired metric card in the carousel -> Open the LinkedIn share dialog with a prefilled message and page URL -> See the platform share window with the prefilled content
Navigate to /[username] -> Attempt to open a share intent but the browser blocks popups -> Share window fails to appear -> See no share confirmation and the user must copy the URL manually

features.name: Dynamic OG Image Generation
features.description: Server endpoint that returns a social preview image generated from the user's avatar and key Wrapped metrics for rich link previews.
user_flows: Share a /[username] URL on a social platform -> Social crawler requests /api/og/[username] -> Server fetches the GitHub profile -> Server renders an OG image with avatar and key metrics and returns the image to the crawler

Share a /[username] URL on a social platform -> Social crawler requests /api/og/[username] -> Server GitHub request returns 404 or is rate-limited -> Server returns a generic fallback OG image or an appropriate error response

known_limitations.issue: Commit data depth is intentionally capped per repo and pages to control latency and API usage
known_limitations.impact: Heavy users may see lower-than-absolute totals for year-wide commits

known_limitations.issue: Stats rely on public GitHub data only
known_limitations.impact: Private repositories and private contributions are excluded

known_limitations.issue: Share-to-social actions use client window.open without in-app confirmation
known_limitations.impact: Popup blocking policies may prevent opening share windows in some browsers
